profile.goodFor: pumping: turning a pad, bass or the music down on every kick, or on a beat grid without a sidechain

settings.name: Amount
settings.what: how far the sound is turned down on each hit

settings.name: Release
settings.what: how fast it comes back up; around a beat's length pumps in time

settings.name: Trigger
settings.what: what turns it down: the sidechain input or a beat grid

settings.name: Curve
settings.what: the shape of the recovery: lower comes back slowly then fast
